review_locator: PMCID:PMC3383398, Group 2 innate lymphoid cells review, ILC tissue-repair section
primary_title: Innate lymphoid cells promote lung-tissue homeostasis after infection with influenza virus
decision_basis: The ILC review cites the primary study showing IL-33-responsive lung ILCs produce amphiregulin, a tissue-repair growth factor.
limitations_preserved: IL-33 in the IL-2/IL-7 culture context increased measured AREG protein from sorted mouse lung ILCs; preserve the protein-output assay and co-factor requirement without adding an unmeasured transcription-to-secretion step.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC3865470, Innate lymphoid cells and type 2 immunity review, IL-33/AREG section
primary_title: IL-33 promotes an innate immune pathway of intestinal tissue protection dependent on amphiregulin-EGFR interactions
decision_basis: The ILC review cites the primary study showing IL-33-elicited gut-associated ILC2s express and produce amphiregulin during intestinal tissue protection.
limitations_preserved: IL-33 in the IL-2/IL-7 culture context increased measured AREG protein from gut-associated mouse ILC2s; preserve the conditioned-medium protein assay and do not infer a separate unmeasured transcription-to-secretion step.

review_locator: https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/immunology/articles/10.3389/fimmu.2020.565275/full, Innate Lymphocytes in Inflammatory Arthritis, ILC2 cytokine-production section
primary_title: Autoimmune Th17 Cells Induced Synovial Stromal and Innate Lymphoid Cell Secretion of the Cytokine GM-CSF to Initiate and Augment Autoimmune Arthritis
decision_basis: The inflammatory-arthritis review cites the primary study showing IL-2 and IL-33 synergistically stimulate GM-CSF production by synovial ILCs.
limitations_preserved: IL-2 plus IL-33 increased measured GM-CSF protein from mouse synovial ILCs; preserve the combination and supernatant assay without asserting an unmeasured transcription-to-secretion step.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC6280706, Interleukin-33 in inflammation and repair review, ILC2 section
primary_title: Group 2 innate lymphoid cells support hematopoietic recovery under stress conditions
decision_basis: The IL-33 review cites the primary study showing IL-33 released from chemotherapy-sensitive B-cell progenitors activates MyD88-dependent GM-CSF secretion by bone-marrow ILC2s.
limitations_preserved: B-cell-progenitor-derived IL-33 activated the measured GM-CSF secretion program in mouse bone-marrow ILC2s after 5-FU stress; preserve the cellular source and stress context without inventing an intermediate transcriptional step.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC6256740, Social networking of group two innate lymphoid cells review, complement/ILC2 section
primary_title: C3a is required for ILC2 function in allergic airway inflammation
decision_basis: The ILC2 review cites the primary study showing C3a directly acts on lung ILC2s and promotes IL-13 production in an IL-33-associated airway context.
limitations_preserved: C3a increased measured IL-13 output from sorted mouse lung ILC2s in the reported complement/cytokine context; preserve the protein assay and C3aR1 dependence without asserting a universal G-protein or transcriptional mechanism.
